summary: Lesson 15: HR Rate Detector. Detects sustained heart-rate level/baseline shifts (mean of recent 7 days with pulse data vs prior baseline window, flag at >= 8 bpm). Surfaces observational medication timing/start/stop and fluid-volume notes around the shift. Save as Gotcha for doctor visits. Informational only — never diagnoses or advises medication/fluid changes. Reuses existing pulse field on BP entries, Advanced Analytics shell, and Gotcha storage.
